title: erp.payment_task.changed.v1
description: An approval task of a payment request (task type erp.payment.request.approval) or an entry (erp.payment.entry.approval), its complete state at each change, by version (be-protocol P17.15). The payload is the protocol's shared task contract; infra/workflow takes it from the publishers its deployment chose. The summary carries only fields its candidates may see: the number, the payee's name or the entry's kind, the amount and the currency; never an account number.
